findings.evidence: Alt text says "a tired child sits holding a glowing phone" while the phrase and all sources (TechCrunch, Common Sense Media, BBC) specifically describe the product and risk as affecting "teenagers"/"teens", not children.
findings.suggestion: Change "child" to "teen" in the alt text so the depicted age group matches the sourced claims and doesn't exaggerate the affected age group.

findings.evidence: Phrase: "Reviewers say the version made for teenagers still keeps chatting through a mental health crisis."
findings.suggestion: The cited sources attribute this to testing/research ('new testing found...', BBC: 'research found...'), not generically to 'reviewers'. Replace 'Reviewers say' with 'Testing found' or 'Researchers found' to track the source wording more precisely.
